style_prompt: Photorealistic live-action family film about a local water outage. Horizontal widescreen 16:9 composition. Use the attached reference images to preserve the exact identities, facial features, hairstyles, clothing and relevant room details. Recompose the portrait references into a natural wide movie shot; reveal believable surrounding space without stretching faces or inserting black bars. Natural daylight, realistic skin texture, restrained warm color grading, subtle film grain, physically plausible movement and water behavior. A single continuous shot, real-time action, no montage, no slow motion, no voice-over, no music, no subtitles or added on-screen titles. Keep characters and props consistent throughout the shot.

scenes.title: Dziewczyna gotuje — widoczna twarz
scenes.reference_notes: Dokładna referencja: dziewczyna ze srebrnymi słuchawkami, granatową bluzą i patelnią w jasnej kuchni.
scenes.prompt: Image 1 defines the girl, silver over-ear headphones, navy sweatshirt, kitchen and frying pan. Eye-level medium shot from the front, her entire face clearly visible in the upper middle of the wide frame and the pan in the foreground. From 0 to 2 seconds she calmly stirs the vegetables and pasta with a wooden spatula, looking down at the food. From 2 to 4 seconds she raises her eyes toward the camera with a small relaxed smile while continuing one gentle stirring motion. A tiny forward camera move, warm window light, faint steam above the pan. Audio: quiet sizzling and soft wooden utensil sounds. Keep her face unobstructed.

scenes.title: Babcia myje włosy pod działającym prysznicem
scenes.reference_notes: Dwie referencje tej samej babci i okrągłej chromowanej deszczownicy w łazience z ciemnymi kaflami.
scenes.prompt: Images 1 and 2 define the same elderly grandmother, gray wet hair, circular chrome rainfall shower and dark tiled bathroom. Respectful close-up cropped strictly from the shoulders upward, with her head and the shower head visible together in a horizontal composition. From 0 to 2 seconds a steady stream falls from the shower while she gently massages a little shampoo into her hair. From 2 to 4 seconds she tilts her head slightly back, closes her eyes comfortably and continues washing; light shampoo lather remains on the crown of her head. Locked camera, subtle steam and realistic water droplets. Audio: steady shower water. The torso remains outside the frame.

scenes.title: Dziewczyna próbuje nalać wodę do garnka — kran nie działa
scenes.reference_notes: Image 1: dokładny pusty garnek, zlew i kran. Image 2: tożsamość dziewczyny i jej strój.
scenes.prompt: Image 1 defines the curved stainless faucet, empty metal pot, sink and wooden kitchen worktop. Image 2 defines the girl with long blonde hair, navy sweatshirt and silver headphones. Wide three-quarter medium shot showing her face on the right and the faucet and pot on the left. From 0 to 1.5 seconds she places the empty pot directly below the spout. From 1.5 to 3 seconds she fully opens the faucet handle, but absolutely no water comes out. From 3 to 5 seconds she looks from the dry spout down into the empty pot, then slightly raises her eyebrows in puzzled frustration. Keep the pot empty and the faucet dry throughout. Audio: metal pot touching the sink, handle click, quiet room ambience.

scenes.title: Woda pod prysznicem ustaje — ostatnie krople i piana na włosach
scenes.reference_notes: Zdjęcia definiują babcię i deszczownicę; piana oraz zanik strumienia są nową akcją.
scenes.prompt: Images 1 and 2 define the grandmother and the same round chrome shower head against dark tiles. Close-up cropped strictly above the shoulders, grandmother's face and shampoo-covered hair below the shower head in the same wide frame. At 0 seconds water is running and a clearly visible white shampoo lather covers the top of her gray hair. From 0 to 2 seconds the stream rapidly weakens. From 2 to 3 seconds only three final separate droplets fall, then the shower becomes completely dry. From 3 to 5 seconds she stops moving, opens her eyes and looks upward directly at the dry shower head with a confused, mildly annoyed expression. The thick foam stays on her hair. Audio: running water fades to a few drops, then silence.

scenes.title: Dziewczyna zgłasza brak wody w aplikacji
scenes.reference_notes: Dokładna referencja dziewczyny z telefonem w kuchni; zlew łączy ujęcie z awarią.
scenes.prompt: Image 1 defines the girl, her navy sweatshirt, silver headphones, smartphone and kitchen. Image 2 defines the nearby dry sink and pot. Three-quarter medium close-up showing her face and the smartphone screen at a readable angle. From 0 to 2 seconds she opens a municipal service app and selects the water outage category, represented by a water-drop icon with a warning mark. From 2 to 4 seconds she taps the large report button once. From 4 to 5 seconds the interface displays a simple green confirmation checkmark and she gives a small satisfied nod. The dry faucet remains in the background. Keep the screen interface simple and stable. Audio: two soft taps and one short confirmation sound.

scenes.title: Babcia zgłasza problem w aplikacji, z pianą na głowie
scenes.reference_notes: Referencja tożsamości babci i łazienki. Nowa sytuacja: babcia wyszła spod prysznica, jest w szlafroku, ma pianę i telefon.
scenes.prompt: Image 1 defines the elderly grandmother's face, gray hair and dark tiled bathroom. Recompose her outside the shower beside the bathroom sink, wearing a fully closed light-colored bathrobe; a conspicuous patch of white shampoo foam remains on her hair. Horizontal medium close-up showing her face and smartphone, with the dry chrome shower softly visible behind her. From 0 to 2 seconds she looks at the phone with patient annoyance and selects the water-drop warning icon in a municipal app. From 2 to 4 seconds she taps the large report button. From 4 to 5 seconds a green confirmation checkmark appears and she exhales with relief. Keep the foam in place. Audio: quiet bathroom ambience, soft tap and confirmation chime.

scenes.title: Chłopak z psem wzrusza ramionami
scenes.reference_notes: Dokładna referencja chłopaka ze smyczą i golden retrieverem; portret dodatkowo utrwala twarz.
scenes.prompt: Image 1 defines the boy in a navy BOSTON hoodie, gray sweatpants, golden retriever, leash and sunlit living room. Image 2 is a supplementary reference for the same boy's face. Horizontal medium shot with the boy on the left and the dog on the right. From 0 to 1 second the boy looks toward his sister just off camera, holding the leash loosely. From 1 to 2 seconds he raises both shoulders in one clear exaggerated shrug, lifting his free palm slightly and raising his eyebrows. From 2 to 3 seconds he lowers his shoulders with a mischievous half-smile. The dog tilts its head once. Audio: faint collar jingle and quiet room tone.

scenes.title: Dziewczyna rusza do drzwi, chłopak i pies podążają za nią
scenes.reference_notes: Image 1 określa drzwi wejściowe, chłopaka i psa. Image 2 określa siostrę, rodzeństwo i salon.
scenes.prompt: Image 1 defines the sunlit living room, front door, boy, golden retriever and leash. Image 2 defines the sister with long blonde hair and navy sweatshirt, and the same sibling pair. Horizontal medium-wide shot opening on the girl's face in three-quarter view. From 0 to 1 second she glances toward her brother with an excited decisive smile. From 1 to 4 seconds she pivots and runs toward the front door; the boy follows one step behind, guiding the golden retriever on the loosely held leash. A quick smooth pan follows their movement across the room toward the doorway. The girl reaches the doorway first. Audio: quick footsteps, leash jingle and clothing rustle.

scenes.title: Mężczyzna w aucie dostaje powiadomienie o braku wody
scenes.reference_notes: Dokładne referencje tego samego kierowcy z telefonem i wnętrza auta.
scenes.prompt: Image 1 defines the adult man with tousled brown hair, short beard, charcoal quarter-zip fleece and his phone inside the car. Image 2 defines the same driver and vehicle interior. Horizontal passenger-side medium close-up; the car is stationary in a roadside parking space. At 0 to 1 second his phone emits one notification sound. From 1 to 3 seconds he raises the phone and reads a municipal alert with a water-drop warning icon and a short Polish line: 'Brak wody: ulice X, Y, Z'. His expression changes from relaxed to practical concern. From 3 to 4 seconds he nods once, lowers the phone into its holder and looks forward, deciding to visit a shop. Audio: notification chime and soft idling engine.

scenes.title: Kierowca zawraca i jedzie do sklepu po wodę
scenes.reference_notes: Ta sama twarz, strój oraz auto. Nowa akcja: powolne zawracanie w szerokim, pustym wyjeździe.
scenes.prompt: Image 1 defines the driver, charcoal fleece, car interior and autumn daylight. Image 2 provides an additional identity reference. Horizontal passenger-side medium shot of the same driver, with the windshield and steering wheel visible. The phone is already secured in its holder. From 0 to 1 second he glances left and activates the turn signal. From 1 to 3 seconds he turns the wheel through one smooth slow U-turn in a broad empty parking-area exit; the road and autumn trees outside rotate naturally relative to the car. From 3 to 4 seconds he straightens the steering wheel and drives toward a small grocery shop visible ahead. Audio: indicator clicks, engine hum and gentle tire noise.

scenes.title: Rodzeństwo wybiega na dwór i biegnie po błocie
scenes.reference_notes: Referencje tożsamości, ubrań i psa. Na zdjęciach brak pleneru; błotnista ścieżka powstaje w generacji.
scenes.prompt: Image 1 defines the sister with long blonde hair, younger brother, their navy sweatshirts, gray sweatpants and golden retriever. Image 2 reinforces the boy and dog. New outdoor setting: a muddy garden path beside their house after rain, warm autumn daylight. Horizontal medium-wide tracking shot from a low three-quarter angle. From 0 to 1 second the siblings run out of the open back doorway onto the path, now wearing outdoor trainers. From 1 to 4 seconds they run side by side through two shallow muddy puddles; each footfall sends small realistic splashes onto their trouser legs. From 4 to 5 seconds they laugh and continue running as the golden retriever trots alongside. Audio: playful laughter, footsteps and wet splashes.

scenes.title: Mężczyzna ładuje zgrzewkę wody do koszyka
scenes.reference_notes: Dokładna referencja sklepu, kierowcy, zgrzewki i wózka; drugie zdjęcie łączy jego tożsamość z autem.
scenes.prompt: Image 1 defines the adult man, charcoal quarter-zip fleece, grocery aisle, blue-wrapped pack of bottled water and shopping trolley. Image 2 confirms that this is the same man who received the car notification. Horizontal medium shot from the front-left, face and both hands visible, trolley in the foreground and bottled-water shelf on the right. From 0 to 1 second he firmly grips one water pack with both hands. From 1 to 3 seconds he lifts it off the shelf and lowers it into the trolley with believable weight. From 3 to 4 seconds he releases the settled pack and briefly looks relieved. One steady continuous movement, fixed camera. Audio: plastic wrapping rustle and trolley rattle.

scenes.title: Ubłocone rodzeństwo patrzy na siebie i zrywa się z kanapy
scenes.reference_notes: Dokładna referencja ubłoconego rodzeństwa z telefonem na kanapie; dodatkowa referencja całego salonu.
scenes.prompt: Image 1 defines the muddy siblings on the beige sofa with their golden retriever and phone. Image 2 defines the same living room and identities. Horizontal medium two-shot, sister on the left, brother on the right, dog between them. Their gray trouser legs are visibly muddy and outdoor shoes have been removed. From 0 to 1 second the sister reads a simple green water-restored confirmation on her phone. From 1 to 2 seconds she turns to her brother, they meet each other's eyes and exchange a competitive grin. From 2 to 3 seconds both spring to their feet at the same time, beginning a playful race toward the bathroom off camera. The dog remains on the sofa. Audio: brief notification, sofa rustle and quick first footsteps.

scenes.title: Wyścig do otwartej łazienki — dziewczyna wbiega pierwsza
scenes.reference_notes: Dokładna referencja biegu w korytarzu do otwartej łazienki; drugie zdjęcie utrwala twarze i błoto na spodniach.
scenes.prompt: Image 1 defines the hallway, wooden floor, staircase, open bathroom doorway and the sister running ahead of her brother. Image 2 confirms their faces, navy tops and muddy gray sweatpants. Horizontal medium-wide rear tracking shot looking straight down the hallway toward the visibly open bathroom. From 0 to 1 second both siblings accelerate into the hallway from the living room. From 1 to 3.5 seconds they race directly toward the open bathroom, the sister clearly maintaining a one-step lead. From 3.5 to 5 seconds she crosses the threshold first and turns back with a triumphant playful smile; her brother arrives just afterward and slows outside. Keep the doorway fully open and their paths separate. Audio: quick socked footsteps and a short laugh.

scenes.prompt: Images 1 and 2 define the same elderly grandmother, wet gray hair, circular chrome rainfall shower and dark tiled bathroom as the earlier outage shots. Respectful horizontal close-up cropped strictly above her shoulders; show her face, crown of her head and running shower together. From 0 to 1 second the shower is flowing strongly again and only a small final patch of shampoo foam remains on her hair. From 1 to 3 seconds she moves her head under the stream and gently sweeps her fingers through her hair; water visibly rinses away the remaining foam. From 3 to 5 seconds her hair is completely foam-free and she closes her eyes with a relieved contented smile. Audio: steady shower water and a relaxed exhale.
